photo.alt: The golden Dome of the Rock seen across Jerusalem
photo.credit: askii, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: 754 m up, on a plateau in the Judaean Mountains
worth_knowing: Holy to Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and one of the oldest cities in the world. Both Israel and Palestine claim it as their capital; neither claim is widely recognised internationally.
